Israel moves to formally recognize Armenian WWI deaths as a genocide
items.description: Israel's Cabinet approved a proposal to designate violence against Armenians by the Ottoman Empire during World War I as a genocide. The step reflects deteriorating ties between Israel and Turkey.

items.title: IDF says troops fired upon in southern Syria, retaliated with helicopter strike
items.description: No injuries caused to Israeli forces in the incident, which took place a day after the military said it killed two gunmen in the Israeli-held buffer zone inside Syria The post IDF says troops fired upon in southern Syria, retaliated with helicopter strike appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.title: Pakistani strikes kill dozens in Afghanistan
items.description: The Taliban government says civilians were killed, while Pakistan maintains they targeted militants.

items.title: Dozens of civilians killed in Pakistani airstrikes in Afghanistan, officials say
items.description: At least 36 civilians have been killed and more than 160 others injured in Pakistani airstrikes in Afghanistan, officials said. Pakistani forces launched a military operation along the border with Afghanistan overnight to Monday in response to multiple militant attacks across Pakistan.

items.title: Pakistan says its security forces killed 29 fighters along Afghan border
items.description: Strikes come a day after fighters armed with guns and explosives killed three soldiers in Karachi.

items.title: Israel recognizes Armenian genocide in rebuke to Turkey
items.description: Successive Israeli governments had avoided formally recognizing the Armenian genocide, in part to preserve relations with Turkey. Relations between Israel and Turkey have sharply deteriorated since the war in Gaza erupted in October 2023.

items.title: Ukrainian Strike Kills 1 in Southern Russia, Refinery on Fire
items.description: Ukraine has targeted Russian energy infrastructure throughout the war in retaliation for Russian strikes on its civilians and energy infrastructure.

items.title: Tears Of Joy As Freed Ukrainians Return Home In Latest Prisoner Swap
items.description: Service members embraced their relatives as they returned home to Ukraine on June 26 in the latest prisoner exchange with Russia. Many of the 160 freed Ukrainians had been held captive since 2022, including soldiers who defended the Azovstal steel plant in Mariupol during a lengthy siege.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian weapons plant, Moscow fuel hub
items.description: The two attacks, in Volgograd and Vladimir regions, are part of President Zelenskyy's strategy to bring the war to the Russian people and force Putin into peace negotiations.

items.title: US strikes Iran in response to attack on ship that Trump says violated ceasefire
items.description: U.S. Central Command said the military struck missile and drone locations and coastal radar sites in Iran. The strikes came shortly after President Donald Trump told reporters, “You’ll find out,” whether the U.S. would response to the drone attack.

items.title: World News in Brief: Violence displaces thousands in Haiti and Lebanon, Gaza updates, UN food agency delivers in Ebola-stricken DR Congo
items.description: More than 2,600 people were displaced in the Artibonite department of Haiti following clashes between armed groups last week as the humanitarian situation continues to worsen, according to the UN’s Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Assistance (OCHA).
